balls.text: oh, this has been sent to the Arabian Sea! My goodness - what a way to finish! Boult misses the leg-stump yorker and dishes out a full toss. David obliges and makes it disappear into the Mumbai night sky over deep mid wicket. RCB finish bang on 240!
speared in very full on leg. Shepherd snaps his wrists into action and whips it towards deep backward square leg
brilliant execution again. On middle stump. David, despite advancing, cannot create the length he wants. Drilled to long off
nails the off-stump yorker. Shepherd cannot get under it either and drives it to long off

pinned on the boot, and that is plumb! Searing yorker on middle and off. Jitesh walks across and misses his sweep. Gets thumped on the front boot and there was only one place that was heading - into the stumps Boult has a wicket and Jitesh, struck by that yorker, limps off!
into the blockhole on leg stump. Not much David can do with that and he clinks it out towards deep mid wicket
low full toss on middle and leg. David cannot get under this and drills it towards long on

top yorker but this ends up sliding just down leg. Did David get bat on it? The umpire thinks it grazed something. David not happy with it and wants to review, only to realize his team has none left...
going, going, gone! Bumrah coming in for some tap now! Slanted into the pads, and this is also a slot ball. David uses the angle and helps it over deep backward square leg!
David gets one away! Bumrah misses the yorker by a smidgen on the shorter side, and travels. On middle stump and David blasts it over the bowler's head!
low full toss on middle and off, and Jitesh cannot quite get a hold of this. Spliced to mid off for a single
zipped in very full on leg. David has a stab at it and squirts it off the inside edge towards short fine leg
brilliant yorker, honing into middle and leg. Jitesh digs it out between deep mid wicket and long on, and hurtles back for a brace

full and wide outside off. Seems to be just inside the tramlines. Jitesh steps down and backs away, and is too far to reach the ball in the end. Jitesh and David have a discussion, presumably about reviewing but RCB are out of reviews...
top work on the fence! Dug in short again, on middle and off. Jitesh opens up his stance and heaves it towards deep mid wicket, where Dhir tumbles to his right and saves two
banged in short on off and this comes onto the batter a little sluggishly. David hacks it off the inside edge into his back leg, and the ball rolls away behind square for a single
kaboom! David makes Hardik pay! This is a buffet ball. Knee-high full toss on middle stump. David gets his front foot out of the way and shovels it over deep mid wicket!

oh dear - that might be a No ball! Waist-high full toss outside off. David swishes hard at it and misses. Called a No ball on the field, but David is disappointed he did not put that away. But hang on, MI have now reviewed, saying this should not be a No ball. Looked above the waist prima facie. David's waist is measured at 1.02m. Ball passes at 1.35m. Call stands!
David shows flexes his muscles! Slower ball bashed half-way down outside off. David fetches it and slaps it past extra cover!
off-cutter on a fullish length on middle and off. David prods it out towards sweeper cover and the 17th over goes for just seven!
full toss, following the batter slightly outside leg. Jitesh tucks it towards deep square leg
right in the blockhole on off, and nothing you can do about that. Jitesh plays it back to the bowler, having done well to get his bat down
slower bumper outside off. Jitesh does not pick it and has a wild swipe across the line. Only connects with fresh air
Jitesh announces his arrival with a boundary! Back of a length on middle and off. Jitesh backs away early and crashes it between mid off and extra cover!
top slower yorker on off. David picks it in time and digs it out towards long on

another shank to long on, and Santner has taken out the RCB skipper! This is really clever bowling. Varied his pace all over long, and this is bowled very full on middle and leg. A tad slower than the previous one perhaps, and Patidar can only pick out long on with a miscue. A stunning knock, but someone else will have to take RCB to 240-250 now!
zipped into the blockhole just outside off. Patidar clinks it back to the bowler
this is incredibly slow, but also way outside off. On a length and Patidar is happy to let it go

darted in very full, attempting to target the pads. Patidar hops inside the line and the umpire calls it a wide. Santner not very pleased, and MI have reviewed it. He could have a case here. Patidar's front leg, when in stance, may have been in line with where the ball pitched, although this is now a slightly subjective matter for the third umpire. Fair delivery, says the third umpire, owing to the aforementioned logic, and finally someone gets a wide review right!

streaky, but it takes Patidar to a sensational fifty! A half-century off just 17 balls. Slow and short outside off. Patidar throws his hands at it and gets enough of an outside edge to send it trickling past the keeper!
fired in full on middle and leg. David drives it to long off and brings Patidar back on strike
into the blockhole outside off. Patidar cannot get under it and cloths it towards deep cover
back of a length outside off. Patidar gets on top of the bounce and punches it towards sweeper cover
back of a length outside off. David hangs back and prods it into the extra cover region

holes out to long on, and Kohli's sluggish knock has come to an end! Full toss outside off. Kohli looks to go downtown but the bat face closes upon impact. Off the bottom half of the blade and SKY, stationed on the fence, does the rest. Kohli departs for a 38-ball 50, and MI finally have their second wicket!

shortish on middle and off. Patidar hacks it off the inside edge into his body. Kohli runs through for the run and before completing it, he pats the rolling ball back to Hardik. Strange. No chance existed of a run-out, of course, but still strange. Hardik had no issue with it

shortish just outside off. Kohli gets up on his toes and tugs it towards deep square leg. Brings up his fifty off 37 balls, which may just be a bit sluggish on the night. No big celebration from Kohli. Perhaps he too is frustrated at not being able to get in the big hits!

short and sliding down leg. Kohli looks to pull it but is beaten by the extra bounce. Tennis-ball bounce in play too. Hardik and the keeper appealed, but Kohli was ready with his 'T' signal to take it upstairs. Fair delivery on line, says the third umpire. Looks good on height too, and Kohli has burnt both RCB reviews trying to pinch a wide. Wow.
very full on off. Kohli gets his bat down in time and clinks it out to long on
attempted yorker but this slides down leg. Kohli does not get bat on it and that is yet another wide
zipped in very full on middle and off. Patidar has a huge hack at it and squirts it off the inside edge behind square
low full toss just outside off. Kohli is hurried on the stroke and stabs it towards long off
into the blockhole on middle and leg. Patidar gives himself room and squeezes it out towards deep point
fetch this too, says Patidar! Boult misses the yorker on the shorter side on off. Patidar sits deep in his crease and slams it over long off!
slower bumper outside off. Patidar waits for it before missing his upper-cut. Called a wide again - this time on height
up and over! Full toss on middle and off. Patidar knows mid off is up and he nonchalantly pops it over the ring!
full and wide outside off again. Kohli steps down the track and slices it towards sweeper cover. Back for another brace
watch out, Shardul! And quite literally too. Full toss outside off. Kohli winds up and thumps it back past the bowler. Shardul tried to get his hands but the ball blitzed through!
full and wide. Kohli gets onto the front foot and drills it enough to sweeper cover's left for a couple of runs
low full toss wide outside off. Patidar reaches out for it and clinks it towards long off

another wide, and this may be getting out of hand now! For MI that is. RCB will not mind it one bit. Slow and short outside off. Patidar gives it all he has and misses. Umpire calls it a wide. MI looking a little puzzled
sliced a mile up, and this carries all the way too! Full and wide. Patidar knows this is going to come and he throws the kitchen sink at it to carve it over deep backward point!

slow, short and wide outside off. Patidar jumps at it, swishes and misses. The umpire has a think about it and then stretches out his arms. Not sure if it was for height or direction. Could have been both
length ball hung up way outside off. Too wide to be deemed a legal ball, though. Some more exercise for the umpire
the runs continue to flow! Gentle and juicy full toss outside off. Patidar has a heave at it and drags it to deep mid wicket's right!
zipped in very full and very wide outside off. Patidar looks to sweep and misses. Called a wide, much to the bowler's annoyance
low full toss on middle and leg. Patidar knocks it to long off and keeps strike
full toss outside off, and this, of all balls, does not travel. Drills it straight to cover point
this is batting of the highest order! On a length wide outside off. Patidar brings out the reverse and nails it over backward point!
this is even bigger, and Patidar is ripping into Markande! Slower but in the slot again. On the pads and Patidar hoists it over deep square leg!
Patidar is not hanging around! Tossed up into the slot on leg stump. Patidar opens up his stance and smears it over deep mid wicket!
very full on leg. Kohli skips down the track and knocks it to long on
off the mark in pristine fashion! Slot ball on off. Patidar plants his front foot, shows the full face of the bat and lifts it over mid off!

plonked straight to extra cover, and guess who has come up trump for MI again! Very full and very wide. Just the line and the length Shardul has his field set for. Salt tries to get under it and lift it over extra cover but because of how full the ball is, he cannot muster the elevation he wants. Simple catch to Hardik and Shardul points to the heavens. The man has done it again!
juicy full toss outside off and Kohli cannot get this away either. Tugs it towards deep mid wicket
into the stumps at the other end! Low full toss outside off. Kohli whips it straight back, and has to settle for a brace via the deflection to long off
this is a top delivery. Right in the blockhole wide outside off. May have been beyond the tramlines but Kohli did seem to move across while trying to dig it out. Was unable to do so in the end
full and a mile outside off again. Kohli swishes at thin air and the umpire indulges in some more exercise
nails the plan again. Very full and very wide outside off. Kohli walks outside off but only clinks it back to the bowler. Would have been a big wide had he left it
starts with a wide yorker that just strays on the wrong side of the tramlines. Kohli swishes and misses. Called a wide this time
low full toss outside off. Salt laces his cover drive but cannot get it past extra cover

banged in short on the stumps. Gets a little big on Kohli and he swats it to long on. Salt is hell-bent on the second. Kohli is not. Salt has to return from half-way and has to scramble to make it back. The dive saves Salt
safe, just about! Back of a length outside off. Salt swishes at it and slices it towards sweeper cover. Boult rattles in off the fence, slides and picks it up on the half-volley
full toss, and no prizes for guessing where that lands! Bread and butter for Salt, and he shovels it over deep square leg!
hard length outside off and this seems like a variation. Salt swings for the hills but swings too early
nails the wide yorker. Right on the tramlines and Salt slices it behind point. Markande sprawls to his left, having run across from deep point, and saves two

almost a catch, but Kohli breaks the shackles in the process! Lobbed up on a length outside off. Kohli fetches it and mows it towards deep mid wicket. Dhir flies low to his left and only manages fingertips to it. Very, very tough chance!

very slow and on a length wide outside off. Drifts in and then spins away. Kohli leaves it and wants the wide. Does not get it, and he reviews. He has an animated chat with Salt, and then goes upstairs. This could be touch-and-go. Kohli has not moved before the release, and the graphic shows a decent chunk of the ball to be inside the tramlines. Kohli burns an RCB review.
shot! Fired in full on the stumps. Kohli plants his front foot, snaps his wrists into action and whips it powerfully back past the bowler. Long on had no chance!
slow and short outside off. Salt has to generate all the pace and he cuts it towards sweeper cover
floated up full and wide. Kohli bends his back knee and shanks it on the bounce to long on. Santner throws his head back in disappointment
very full outside off. Kohli jams down on it and digs it out towards extra cover
googly on a fullish length outside off. Kohli gets down on one knee and drags it towards deep mid wicket
back of a length delivery down leg. Salt stays back and helps it round the corner. Some normalcy returns (from an MI POV)
this goes all the way now! A mirror image of Santner's first over! Another drag-down on leg. Salt waits for it and plunders it over deep square leg!
three fours on the spin, and Salt is not sparing Markande either! Markande not helping himself by dragging it half-way down. Salt sits back and slaps it past extra cover!
four more! On the shorter side but further width offered this time. Salt sits deep in his crease and cracks it just behind point!

another spinner greeted with a boundary! And Salt brings up a 25-ball fifty! Slider on a back of a length on middle. Salt rocks back and hammers it between long on and deep mid wicket. Salt is pumped and up for the occasion!
back of a length outside off. Salt goes back and across before jabbing it towards sweeper cover
lucky escape for Kohli! Fired in very full outside off. Kohli looks to go inside-out and nearly drags it back onto his stumps. Gets a single to short fine leg
tossed up nicely on a length outside off. Drifts in and then straightens to go past Kohli's flailing blade
full toss outside off. Salt winds up and drills it towards long off
much fuller, quicker and wider outside off. Kohli digs it out towards sweeper cover
slowed up on a back of a length outside off. Kohli waits for it before slapping it straight to extra cover
searing yorker, honing into the pads. Kohli gets bat on it and glances it down to fine leg
off-pace, on a back of a length outside off. Salt reads it very late and chunks it off the inside half of the bat into the mid on region
slower bumper outside off and this seems to balloon over the batter. Called a wide as Salt lets it go. He did back away to flay it over the off side, though
full and speared into the pads. Salt flicks it neatly behind square and Tilak tears across to his right from deep square leg to rein it in
back of a length, just outside off. Salt rides the bounce and opens his bat face to run it down to short third
hard length, angling into off. Kohli opens up his stance and hacks it down to fine leg

safe on the catching count, and on the run out too! Low full toss on the stumps. Kohli pops it on the bounce to mid on. Salt sets off, only to be sent back. Santner hits the stumps at Bumrah's end but Salt has made it back by then
slowed up considerably, on a back of a length outside off. Salt tries to hit it too hard and scuffs it into the off side. Decent comeback by Santner after conceding 22 off the first four
Santner gets away with that. Full and sneaking down leg. Salt laces it but hits it straight to short fine leg
just a four, and that tells you how this over is going! Given lots of air and hung up wide outside off. Salt fetches it and bulldozes a slog-sweep past mid on!
three in a row, and Salt is tearing Santner to shreds here! Another drag-down, on middle stump. Salt rocks back and pummels it over deep square leg!
up, up and away! Flighted this time, but in the slot on leg stump. Salt gets his front foot out of the way and clubs it a mile over wide long on!
welcomed with a maximum! Dragged down on middle and leg. Sits up and Salt has all the time in the world to heave it over the deep square leg fence!
very full and wide outside off. Kohli plays with an open bat face and squeezes it past backward point for another brace
into the blockhole on middle and leg. Salt jams down on it and clinks it out towards mid on
slower bumper outside off. Salt jumps up onto his toes and hacks it through mid wicket for a couple of runs

lbw shout, not given! Sizzling full ball, tailing into leg stump. Kohli plays all over it and gets pinged on the back leg. Might have been sliding down leg. Might have gotten bat on it too. UltraEdge confirms bat was involved
slow, short, wide and punished! Not entirely in control but Kohli will take it. Throws his hands at it, while also leaping in the air, and gets it over short third!
low full toss speared into the pads. Kohli, while advancing, misses his flick and gets pinged on the knee roll. Heading well down, though
much better bumper on off, climbing through and doing so at pace. Salt swipes at it and feels the ball whistle past his flailing blade
low full toss just outside off. Salt has a swing at it and drags it towards mid wicket
right out of the screws! Salt is doing alright now! Some riposte after the blow the previous ball. Half-tracker just outside off and Salt dumps it into the sea of blue over mid wicket!
shortish on middle and leg, and this skids through. Salt is rushed on the pull and misses. Cops a blow in the abdomen region for his troubles
back of a length on middle and leg. Kohli gives himself room before dabbing it towards backward point
smashed! Length outside off and that is all Kohli needs. He charges down and thumps it over mid off. Lands just before the rope!
back of a length just outside off. Kohli skips down and drops it into the off side for another sharp single
length outside off and this stops in the surface a touch. Kohli lunges at it and prods it towards extra cover
length just outside off. Salt comes forward and pushes it towards cover. Looks at his partner, who responds and saunters across
full and sliding down leg. Salt does not get bat on it and the umpire has no qualms in calling it a wide
shot! Shortish and sitting up outside off. Salt goes across his stumps, gets his hands through the ball and blitzes it between mid off and extra cover!
full outside off. Salt walks across his stumps and shovels it uppishly between mid on and mid wicket. Back for a brace
banged in short outside off. Salt looks for the pick-up pull but chalks it off the toe-end towards mid off
hard length, shaping back into off. Salt, a tad cramped for room, chops it into the point region
Salt finds the fence too! Shortish on leg. Salt spots the length early, backs away and thrashes it past extra cover!
back of a length just outside leg. Shapes back in a touch and Kohli, charging down the track, squirts it off the inside edge towards fine leg
a whip of the wrists, and Kohli is up and running! Full and swinging into the pads. Kohli snaps his wrists into action and sends it soaring flat over deep square leg!
oh! Length ball on off and this curves back in nicely too. Kohli falls across and plays all around it to get pinged on the back thigh
length ball on leg, and this shapes in. Salt tips it to mid on and sets off for the single. A direct hit ensues but Salt has done well to make it

six more to finish the game, but RCB have won by 18 runs! Another missed yorker and this is in the slot outside off. Rutherford plants his front foot and thumps it over the sightscreen. Does not matter in the grander scheme, though. RCB have come to Mumbai, and they have outdone the five-time champions again!
Rutherford with another gorgeous six. Low full toss outside off. Rutherford bends his back knee to get under it and creams it over cover!
this should have been the penultimate ball of the game but Shepherd bowls a wide. Of course he does. Misses the mark with a wide yorker
very full and very wide. Rutherford cannot get under this and pushes it towards extra cover
another mighty hit! Short outside off and this sits up nicely. Rutherford loads up and clatters it a mile over deep mid wicket!
back of a length outside off. Rutherford throws the kitchen sink at it and misses. Looks like Rutherford wanted the review but there aren't any left!
back of a length delivery wide outside off. Rutherford lets it go and the umpire calls it a wide. Neither side has any reviews left now

smashed, and we have another review. Phew. Waist-high full toss on leg. Rutherford smacks it over deep backward square leg. Wants to check the height, and we have to wait for Ball Tracking. Waist measured at 1m, with the ball passing at 0.97m. Fair delivery; just the six for Rutherford!
Very full on the pads. Rutherford flicks it towards mid wicket
jammed out for another single
Top yorker, on middle stump. Rutherford jams it out towards long on
Low full toss just outside leg. Rutherford misses and gets pinged on the pad. Impact outside leg, though
Full ball sliding into the pads. Rutherford gets enough bat on it and glances it past short fine leg!
Into the blockhole on middle and leg. Santner digs it out towards long off
full ball down leg and it is raining wides now. No bat involved, so easy decision for the umpire
half-tracker outside off. Sits up nicely and Rutherford boshes it flat over the wide long on fence!
short and wide outside off. Rutherford lets it go and the umpire signals for a wide, while having a big smile on his face. Thankfully now review this time

another short ball outside off. Rutherford swings and misses. No wide called but Rutherford wants to check with the third umpire now. He is arguing for a wide on height. Head measured at 1.87m. Ball passing at 1.8m. Wide not given!
Short and wide again. Another air-shot for Rutherford. Umpire calls it a wide but RCB want to have another look. Of course. This is beyond the tramlines, so the wide is called.
Juicy full toss outside off. Rutherford lines it up and smokes it over long on!
short and wide outside off. Bowled from around the wicket and Rutherford wafts at thin air again
Rutherford with another six! Low full toss on middle and leg. Rutherford clears his front leg and hoicks it over wide long on!

short and wide outside off. Rutherford swishes and misses, and the umpire calls it a wide. Patidar has a wry smile on his face and then goes upstairs. Duffy did not like the initial call anyway. Wide overturned on review, so this will be a legal ball, after all!
full ball speared down leg. Rutherford swings and misses. Called a wide
slower short ball outside off. Santner leaps into the air to manufacture something behind point but fails to make contact
very full on middle and off. Rutherford drives it to long on. Just another single, though
off-pace and banged in short on middle and leg. Santner swipes it towards deep mid wicket
slower bumper just outside off. Santner gets up on his toes and slashes it over backward point. Consolatory runs at this stage, by the looks of it!
very full on middle and leg. Not much room to work with and Rutherford drills it to long on
into the blockhole on middle and leg. Rutherford jams it out between long on and deep mid wicket, and canters back for a brace
full again, targeting the stumps. Rutherford swings for the fences and skews it off the top edge. Taken by Patidar at extra cover but this will not count either!

and Shepherd gets a wicket immediately! Superb catch to boot too, but Shepherd has overstepped. More drama! Full on middle and leg. Rutherford skies it and Shepherd runs into the mid wicket region to pouch it. Brilliant catch but it will not count!
excellent wide yorker outside off. Rutherford cannot jam it out this time
slower ball on a length on middle and leg. Santner squeezes it out into the off side
another soft dismissal!
low full toss outside off. Rutherford drills it out towards long off. Rasikh pulls up again but he will solider on
pick the bones out of this one! Dragged down outside off and Rutherford feasts on it. He rocks back and pummels it over deep mid wicket!
zipped in full on the pads. Rutherford tucks it into the on side and keeps strike
dug into the track again, outside off. Dhir jumps up onto his toes and cuts it uppishly towards sweeper cover

a terrible miscue, and Hardik is done for the night! Full and wide outside off. Hardik nearly swings himself off his feet and loses his shape completely. Off the outer half of the blade and Shepherd completes the easiest of catches at deep backward point. MI spiraling now!
banged in short outside ff and this climbs through. Hardik, having taken a step across, swishes at it and misses
nicely done! On the shorter side again and laced with width. Hardik waits on it and steers it between backward point and short third!
in the slot outside off. Hardik throws everything at it and slices it towards long off, where Salt dives to his left and keeps it to two
short and wide outside off. Hardik thinks about playing at it before letting it go. Big wide
slanted in on a length on leg, and denying the batter any room. Hardik squeezes it out towards long on
fired in on a length on middle and off. Rutheford gets caught on the crease and pokes it to long off
Rutherford goes massive! In the arc, and out of the park. Rutherford has swinging room, with this length ball on leg, and he wallops it over deep mid wicket!
back of a length outside off. Hardik hangs back and flat-bats it towards long off
Krunal puts down his brother! Back of a length outside off. Hardik lines it up and smashes it flat towards long on. Krunal seems to get both hands to it high to his left but spills it!
flighted up on a fullish length outside off. Rutherford heaves it towards deep mid wicket
back of a length delivery wide outside off. Rutherford reaches out for it and shanks it towards long on
another short ball outside off. Quite brisk too and Rutherford is late on the upper-cut
round-arm, on a back of a length outside off. Hardik uses the pace and dabs it towards deep backward point
quick and shortish just outside off. Rutherford jabs it towards deep point and opens his account

swiped straight to deep backward square leg, and Krunal comes up with the breakthrough again! Tossed up on a length on leg. SKY looks for the sweep but the lack of pace means he has to generate all the power. Off the top edge and an easy catch for Rasikh on the fence!
seam-up short ball outside off. Hardik stays back and cuts it towards sweeper cover
speared in way outside off. Left alone and called a wide
SKY with another last-ball boundary! A touch short and enough width on offer. SKY frees his arms and thrashes it through cover!

darted in on a length on the stumps. SKY jabs it back towards the bowler, who gets a hand to it and deflects it towards long on. Hardik, in trying to regain his ground, threw himself to the turf, only to get up theatrically moments later
shortish just outside off. SKY sits deep in his crease and stabs it enough to long on's right for a couple of runs
back of a length on middle and off. Hardik opens up his stance and drags it towards long on
fired in on a length outside off. Hardik tries to tonk it into tomorrow and misses it completely
streaky, but much-needed! Dragged half-way down outside off. Hardik has an agricultural swipe at it and the ball hurtles off the toe-end past the keeper!
short, wide and would have been a wide had SKY left it. He chases after it and toe-ends it to short third
full outside off. Hardik gets onto the front foot and drives it towards long off
juicy full toss outside off and Hardik misses out. Swishes hard at it but does not lay bat on ball
shot! Bhuvneshwar misses the yorker by a bit on middle, and he gets carted over his head. Such pure timing, and such a great connection!
full toss outside off. Hardik's bottom hand comes off as he flays at it, and scuffs it towards backward point
Hardik begins the over with a boundary! Shortish and sliding into the hips. Hardik rolls his wrists and helps it past short fine leg!
very full just outside leg. Hardik digs it out towards long on
Hardik wants a piece of Suyash too! On a length on off. Hardik stays leg side of the ball and scythes it ferociously past backward point!
back of a length outside off. SKY has a hack at it and shanks it towards long on
back of a length outside off. SKY presses half forward and jabs it towards backward point
back to back boundaries! Short and wide outside off. SKY throws his hands at it and knifes it past backward point!
nicely done! Fullish just outside off. SKY shuffles across, gets down on one knee and sweeps it over short fine. Salt with a valiant dive but in vain!
the bouncer does arrive. Just outside off and Hardik watches it well to sway out of the way
back of a length outside off. Punched out towards sweeper cover

big lbw shout, not given! Darted in full on middle and leg. Seems to go on with the arm. Raps SKY on the pad as he misses his sweep. Was it heading down? RCB do not think so and review. And this turns out to be a wasted review. Impact itself is Umpire's Call and the ball is heading well down leg. SKY stays!
tossed up full on off. Hardik stretches forward and knocks it to long off
length on off. SKY presses forward and pushes it towards long off
full outside off. SKY gets onto the front foot and drives it towards deep point, where Shepherd fumbles and ends up conceding the second
and Hardik is here to play! On a length outside off. Hardik plants his front foot and thumps it over long off. Now then!

simple catch to short fine leg, and this chase is flagging now! Seems like another googly. On a length outside leg. Tilak looks to sweep but the ball bounces just enough to take the top edge. Spoons up to Duffy, and that is an incredibly soft dismissal. RCB tighten their grip further!
back of a length on the stumps. SKY hangs back and stabs it towards deep mid wicket
googly on a back of a length on middle and leg. Tilak goes back and works it towards deep mid wicket
googly on a length on the pads. Tilak comes forward and prods it towards the bowler

goes straight up, and Rickelton falls! Seems like a googly, hung up full and wide. Rickelton has a wild mow across the line and the ball skews up off the top edge. Bhuvneshwar calls for it early, settles under it in the short third region and does the rest. Vital, vital wicket for RCB!
four to finish the over! Slanted in on a length on leg. SKY moves across his stumps, gets down low and paddles it over short fine. One bounce and into the fence!
speared in full on the pads. Rickelton looks for the sweep but misses, with the ball rolling off his pad behind square
fullish on off. SKY gets onto the front foot and punches it uppishly towards long off
slowed up on a full length just outside off. Rickelton has a mow at it and squirts it off the inside edge towards deep backward square leg
fired in on a length on leg. SKY eases it out to long on
angled in full on the pads. SKY comes forward and works it between long on and deep mid wicket. Back for a brace
juicy full toss on middle and leg. SKY knocks it to long on and keeps strike
another slower ball, bowled into the track outside off. SKY waits on it before scuffing it to mid off
SKY with his first boundary! Dipping low full toss outside off. SKY picks it early, reaches out in front and scorches it back past the bowler!
off-pace on a back of a length outside off. SKY hangs back and punches it to mid off

back of a length on off. Skids off the surface and Rohit blocks it into the on side. And Rohit has pulled the plug on this innings for now. The movement is not good enough, he reckons, and Rohit is retiring hurt.
slower ball on a full length on the stumps. Rickelton bunts it to mid off and calls for the single. Rickelton hares across; Rohit not as fluent
shot! Speared in full and wide. More or less the perfect wide yorker but Rohit still manages to get his hands through the ball, and carve it between cover point and backward point!
round-arm, on a length on the pads. Rickelton tucks it towards deep mid wicket
back of a length, following the batter outside leg. Rohit has a swing at it and misses, with the ball dribbling off his thigh pad towards short fine
the seam-up bumper is out. Not very short, though. Hip-high around off stump and hacked into the leg side
low full toss hung up wide outside off. Rohit reaches out and clinks it towards long off
back of a length just outside off. Rohit gets caught on the crease and stabs it back to the bowler
finds the gap this time! Low full toss just outside off. Rickelton gives himself room and then, with a flick of the wrists, threads it between mid off and extra cover!
right up in the blockhole, just outside off. Rickelton gets his bat down and jams it out towards the bowler
nicely-disguised slower ball, dipping on a length on middle and off. Cuts away and Rickelton, nibbling at it, is beaten on the outside
low full toss slanting into the pads. Rohit helps it towards deep backward square leg
slower ball on a back of a length just outside off. Rohit backs away before chopping it behind point
just beyond Shepherd! Full outside off. Rohit looks to go downtown and shanks it. Just enough mustard on it to evade mid on to his left!
dug in short outside off. Rohit goes back and across before cutting it towards sweeper cover
Rohit lands his first punch now! Angled into the slot on leg. Rohit dances down the track and launches it over mid wicket!
slower ball on a back of a length outside off. Rickelton pushes it towards mid on and saunters across to the other end
this is a shot and a half! Marginally short outside off. Rickelton gets on top of the bounce and whacks it over deep mid wicket!
short and wide outside off. Rickelton jumps up onto his toes and scuffs it towards extra cover. Rickelton very disappointed with himself
four more - Rickelton motoring along now! Slower bumper outside leg. Rickelton rolls his wrists and razes it into the long leg fence!
a direct hit, and it might have been very close! Fullish just outside off. Rickelton drives it to mid off and calls for the single. Might have been struggling had the fielder hit his mark!
this is a Rickelton special! Full and swinging into the pads. Rickelton plants his front foot and clips it over the long leg fence!
back of a length just outside off. A bit of shape away and Rohit bunts it towards mid on to keep things ticking
full just outside off. Rickelton comes forward and pushes it enough to mid off's right for a single
short and sitting up on middle and leg. Rohit swivels and pulls it towards long leg
into the blockhole on middle and leg. Rohit jams down on it and digs it out towards mid wicket
full and slanted well down leg. Rohit does not get bat on it and the umpire has no qualms in calling it a wide
shot! That has screeched across the turf. Shortish outside off. Rickelton jumps up onto his toes and cracks it through cover!
on the shorter side again, angling across the batter wide outside off. Rickelton has a swipe at it and only connects with fresh air
short and wide outside off. Rickelton gets up on his toes and jabs it towards extra cover
Rickelton is underway! Marginally short just outside off. Rickelton picks it up and dumps it over deep square leg. Did not get all of it, but got enough!
oh! Fullish in the channel just outside off. Rickelton has a waft at it and sees the ball sneak past the outside edge
full outside off, shaping into Rickelton. He comes forward and pokes it towards mid off
